description: This Java class (HttpPublisherActor) is responsible for publishing messages to an HTTP endpoint within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages request creation, message serialization, request queuing, response handling, and response validation for outbound messages sent via HTTP.

classes.name: HttpPublisherActor
classes.description: A final class extending BasePublisherActor, responsible for publishing messages over HTTP, managing request queue, response processing, and validation within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Actor Props for HttpPublisherActor instances.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup by shutting down the KillSwitch when actor stops.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines if a given acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: A hook method for pre-processing, currently a no-op.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Handles stream termination failures by notifying parent actor.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into an HttpPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Creates and enqueues an HTTP request to publish a message, returning a future with the command response.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Constructs an HttpRequest from the external message, setting appropriate headers and payload.

methods.name: getHttpHeadersPair
methods.description: Extracts headers and content type for HTTP requests from message headers.

methods.name: handleQueueOfferResult
methods.description: Handles the result of offering requests to the source queue asynchronously.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes the HttpResponse received, calling onResponse on the associated context.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new HttpPushContext that manages response processing for a request.

methods.name: toCommandResponseOrAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts an HttpResponse into a CommandResponse or acknowledgement, validating response contents.

methods.name: validateLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if the live HTTP response matches the expected signal details, throwing errors if inconsistencies are found.

methods.name: handleInvalidResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid responses by logging and throwing a MessageSendingFailedException.

methods.name: toMessageCommandResponse
methods.description: Parses a JSON object into a specific MessageCommandResponse based on response headers and content.

methods.name: toCommandResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON into a CommandResponse object, expecting a specific signal type.

methods.name: toConnectionFailure
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionFailure object based on stream errors.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Augments DittoHeaders with headers from the HTTP response, including content type.

methods.name: getPayloadAsBytes
methods.description: Returns the payload bytes from an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns the text payload of an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns the byte payload of an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the HTTP response body into a JsonValue, respecting size limits.

methods.name: stripUserInfo
methods.description: Removes user info from a Uri.
